2018-3216-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2018-3216-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3234-3293-4247-5412.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4247-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-4247-5412.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

824-2511-2728-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2511-2728-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2511-2728-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

880-3875-7893.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7832-7834.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7832-7834.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

876-3151-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Elves.
876-3151-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Elvish Archdruid.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Elvish Archdruid.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Elvish Archdruid.
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Elvish Archdruid.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Elvish Archdruid.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Elvish Archdruid from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

236-1978-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Bring to Life.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

2092-2757-3381-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Morgue Toad from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Morgue Toad, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Morgue Toad by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2203-2366-5434-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-5434-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

710-5147-7424.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

650-891-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4116-6586.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Vivi that is a 7/5 and retains its ability.
Activate Volrath by paying {0}, adding seven mana in any combination of {U} and/or {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Sailor of Means

1409-5184-5424.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve the Sailor of Means trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2281-6132-6797.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

104-1496-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1496-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-567-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-567-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1483-4050-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Weaponcraft Enthusiast from your graveyard to your hand.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast and a Servo, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

6843-6899.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, With Great Power... causes that damage to be redirected to Anti-Venom.
Anti-Venom will then prevent the damage and put that many +1/+1 counters on it instead.

4740-5078-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
4740-5078-6900.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, drawing a card and then putting Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, gaining you 1 life for each spell you have cast this turn.
Repeat until your life total is 52 or greater.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a coin counter on it

1349-5256-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
1349-5256-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

913-3525-3586.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2} and causing you to copy the next ability you activate or spell you cast that has {X} in its cost.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
Once you have a large number of delayed triggers, cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its cost to have Magus Lucea Kane copy that spell or ability infinitely.

856-5632-5686-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3765-6316.description:
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
When Vela leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

2292-2781-4875-6243.easyPrerequisites: any type other than "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
2292-2781-4875-6243.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Conspiracy. Choose any creature type except "Angel" as Conspiracy enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

851-2933-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

413-439-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Arashin Sovereign.
413-439-4766-5683.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, causing you to put it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Arashin Sovereign and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Arashin Sovereign from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
When Arashin Sovereign enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

62-2489-3341.notablePrerequisites: Savage Ventmaw and Charnelhoard Wurm do not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
62-2489-3341.description:
Declare Charnelhoard Wurm and Savage Ventmaw as attackers.
Savage Ventmaw triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Charnelhoard Wurm.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

962-2092-4449-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash does not have summoning sickness.
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
962-2092-4449-4613.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash using Hateflayer's ability by paying at most {1}{R} and untapping it, causing Yurlok of Scorch Thrash to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

152-1308-2034-5446.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

703-1622-4772.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Minion Reflector trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Doubling Season that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Minion Reflector trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens with haste.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Doubling Season tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

914-1075-2068-2292.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1075-2068-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Viscera Seer's ability.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate Bonecaller Cleric by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing it, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bonecaller Cleric's ability, with the copy targeting Bonecaller Cleric.
Resolve both Bonecaller Cleric abilities, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1339-1636-3307.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Advisors, Monks and/or Artificers.
1339-1636-3307.description:
Activate The Archimandrite by tapping three Advisors, Monks and/or Artificers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

7-539-1899-2232-2692.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter among creatures you control.
7-539-1899-2232-2692.description:
Cast Beastcaller Savant for {G}, triggering Felidar Retreat and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger choosing not to return another permanent.
Resolve Felidar Retreat's trigger, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
The Cat Beast token triggers Cloudstone Curio.
Tap Beastcaller Savant, adding {G}.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger returning Beastcaller Savant to your hand.
Repeat.

3519-4347.description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling Misthollow Griffin, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Cast Misthollow Griffin from exile by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
